conventions.shard_shape: one chapter object per file (same shape as one element of structured_story.json chapters[]): id/order/title/heading/word_count/body_word_count/source{file,line_start,line_end}/paragraph_count/scenes[]; scene = id, boundary_reason, setting, present[], source (paragraph range), paragraphs[], dialogues[], entities[]. Matches the b03 shard layout so p0-merge can assemble all shards the same way
conventions.paragraph: maximal block of non-blank lines after the chapter heading line, numbered pNN in file order; text = the lines joined by single spaces, verbatim (curly quotes, em dashes, _italics_ markers and source typos such as 'p ennyworth' kept as-is); lines = [first, last] 1-based file line numbers
conventions.ids: scene chNNN-scNN, paragraph chNNN-pNN, dialogue chNNN-dNNNN (sequential across the chapter); all prefixed by chapter id, so they cannot collide with other batches
conventions.dialogue_types: dialogue (spoken aloud, incl. 'said to herself' asides -> delivery 'to herself'), thought ('thought Alice'), verse (sung/recited/read-aloud poems, one entry per stanza paragraph). Nested quotations inside a line (quoted poem lines, newspaper phrase, song-character voices) stay inside the carrying line and are not split off
conventions.dialogue_text: exact substrings of the paragraph with the outer quotation marks removed; when narration interrupts one speaker's line, the segments are joined with ' [...] '
conventions.excluded_quotes: not extracted as lines: word-mentions inside narration (ch011#p04 'creatures', 'jury-men'; ch011#p08 'stupid'), and text written on the slates (ch011#p08 'stupid things!', ch012#p13 'important'/'unimportant', ch012#p49 the jury's note). Each case is noted on the nearest dialogue entry or listed here
conventions.speakers: surface names as they appear in the text (Alice, Gryphon, Mock Turtle, King, Queen, White Rabbit, Hatter, March Hare, Dormouse, Knave, Cook, Alice's sister); unnamed individuals the text identifies ('one of the jury', 'one of the jurymen', 'another of the jurymen') are recorded as written with speaker_kind 'unnamed_individual' — they are not counted as UNKNOWN because the text says who they are. No canonical character IDs are assigned
conventions.entities: one entry per (mention, paragraph) with count = whole-token occurrences of the mention in that paragraph (case-sensitive); type person|place|item|skill; key = tentative lowercase slug for later unification only (not a CHAR-/LOC- id). Covered: all named characters and speaking creatures, plus key places and props. Pronouns are not tagged. Characters inside songs or poems and figures only mentioned or recalled are tagged with a note
conventions.editorial_brackets: ch010#p59 and ch010#p70 are '[later editions continued as follows ...]' insertions in the source file. They are kept as paragraphs, and their verse lines are extracted as verse attributed to Alice (confidence 0.8) with a note that they are later-edition text, not this edition's main text
